changelog:
- Initial release of affine-cli: a command-line tool for managing Affine documents, tags, folders, collections, databases, comments, journals, and workspaces.
- Supports both cloud (app.affine.pro) and self-hosted Affine deployments.
- Provides a wide range of commands for workspace, document, tag, folder, collection, file, database, comment, and journal management.
- Offers flexible configuration via environment variables, local .env, or global config file.
- Includes quick-start instructions and common usage examples for key features.
summary: Command-line tool to manage Affine documents, tags, folders, databases, comments, journals, and workspaces on cloud or self-hosted servers.
